title: Osmosis
description: Water crosses a membrane toward the saltier side, pulled with the pressure π = iMRT. Push back harder and it flows the other way. Unlocks the Reverse Osmosis Cell.

puzzle.goal: A salt splitting into i ions is dissolved at M moles a litre. Write the pressure p that pulls water toward it at temperature T, with the gas constant R.
puzzle.name: Van 't Hoff law
puzzle.ask: Find p in bar for seawater: i = @{i}, M = @{M} mol/L, R = @{R} L·bar/(mol·K), T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: Dissolved particles act like a gas in the water: pV = nRT, per litre.
